agents.name: Frontend & React TS Specialist
rules: Default to Server Components; use 'use client' only for interactive leaves
Use Tailwind for layout and Ant Design for data-dense widgets
Tokens must come from tokens.css; no arbitrary hex codes
Never import database drivers or server secrets into apps/web

agents.name: Node.js Backend & API Specialist
rules: Enforce Clean Architecture: Route -> Service -> Repository
Use Repository Port & Adapter pattern; never leak ORMs into domain services
